name: 最近検索した場所の行
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Create ONE Lighthouse catalog component LH01-0002 最近検索した場所の行. This is a single recent-location row for selecting a previously searched facility.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: image1 ORIGINAL Google Maps screenshot controls icon glyph geometry/proportions/optical weight, fine details, alignment and spacing. Relevant source region x47 y521 width1097 height178: the first recent-place row, a simple clock in a pale neutral gray circle, two lines of text, and an inset bottom hairline. Image2 is our saved rough mock, secondary guide only for Japanese text and overall isolated row. Its mint/green icon circle is an inaccurate styling adaptation; do not copy it. Image3 is approved Lighthouse surface style only; copy no bus/map content.
Preserve exact Japanese text from our localization: first line "中目黒の集会所", second line "東京都目黒区". Only one row, no heading, extra locations, count, chevron, button, search field or keyboard. Clock at left; text starts to its right, both lines left aligned; hairline divider starts aligned with the text column. Reproduce the original clock's clean circular outline with vertical hour hand and diagonal minute hand, compact optical weight; don't invent malformed vectors.
Official style: pure #FFFFFF canvas and row, fine neutral divider, no nested card. Utility clock #526173 in a small neutral light-gray disc, no green or mint icon circle. Accent decision: original row has neutral history icon and no selected state; omit extra color because it conveys no functional state. White spacious enough for touch but visually compact. Meiryo Regular first line14px/24px, metadata12px/16px, tracking0, no bold; uniformly scaled from logical390px row, single line per label. Main text #1D1D1D, metadata #6E6E6E. Flat frontal high-resolution UI on wide3:1 white canvas with modest margins, no perspective or extra product copy.
reviewNotes: 原画面を時計の図形・太さ・整列の優先入力として使用。モックの緑とミント円を中立グレー円とスレート時計へ修正。選択状態や色の機能がないため追加アクセントなし。日本語2行、中目黒の集会所・東京都目黒区、時計、本文位置から始まる区切り線を視認。余計な行や操作、欠けなし。静止画像エージェントレビューのみ、厳密フォント一致・所有者承認・ネイティブ編集・実装は未証明。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
